model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for per-specialty terms across six medical specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—when evaluated against a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) and its fine-tuned variants. The horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms,” lists the six specialties in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from -27 to -22, with tick marks at regular intervals of one unit. Each specialty has a single bar representing the Mistralv0.2-Base model (light blue), and six additional bars representing the fine-tuned models, each distinguished by color: light beige for Cardio, light orange for Gastro, orange for Infect, dark orange for Neuro, brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics. The bars are grouped under each specialty, with the base model bar positioned to the left of the fine-tuned bars. All bars extend downward from the horizontal axis, indicating negative values on the log probability scale; the Mistralv0.2-Base bar for Cardio reaches approximately -26.5, while the corresponding fine-tuned bars range from about -25.5 to -26.5. The chart does not indicate any sorting of bars by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color-coding and grouping.
